title: Broken piece not replaced!!
text: Broken piece not replaced!!. Broken piece.  Contacted seller and manufacturer and both promised that the broken piece would be replaced.  I have yet to see it so the drawers can't be put together since this broken piece goes between drawers.

product_metadata.title: Tribesigns Rustic Sofa Console Table with 2 Drawers, 47 inch Industrial Entryway Hallway Table TV Stand with Storage Shelves for Living Room, Entrance
features: 【Vintage Style Sofa Table/Entry Table with Storage】: This Industrial-chic Look hall table would compliment your furniture and bring function to your living area without taking up too much space. It can go anywhere you wanted---behind the sofa/couch, entryway, foyer, an empty hall and more

【Large Storage Capacity,Less Disorder】: 2 Spacious drawers provide extra room for you to hide the mess out of sight, and the bottom mesh shelf provide plenty of space for convenient storage, 47”L x 15.8”W large tabletop is ideal for lamps, photos, books, ornaments and more

【Long-Lasting Support, Stable Construction】: The entryway table constructed of 0.59” durable particle board with sturdy mental frame to ensure large weight capacity, drawers runs on metal guide rails with safe stops, no worries that drawers will fall off accidentally
【Works Well as TV Stand】: The entry table is 15.8” deep, wide enough to work as a TV stand/media entertainment center for flat screen TV, cable box, game consoles

【Buy with Confidence】: Every piece is labeled and all hardware, tools with instructions are included in the package for easy assembly. (All products come with 18 months of quality assurance and friendly customer service)
